title: Summoning Glow — LED Dragon Display
descriptionHtml:
Seven lights. One dragon. The room changes when it wakes.

Summoning Glow turns a coiled dragon silhouette into an illuminated centerpiece. The painted green figure rises above seven translucent spheres while warm light moves through the clear base and sculpted amber energy effects.

Why it earns center shelf

  • Display presence: an approximately 6 in / 15–16 cm dragon figure with a layered, full-circle silhouette.
  • Lights-on impact: a wired concentric-ring LED base creates a warm amber glow beneath the entire scene.
  • Depth from every angle: translucent spheres, crystal-like effects, painted scales, and clear supports build a display that rewards a closer look.

What is included

  • Painted PVC dragon display figure and internal support stand
  • Wired clear LED display base
  • Seven separate translucent orange star-marked spheres
  • Translucent amber crystal and energy-effect pieces
  • Clear structural supports

Assembly: This display arrives in multiple components and requires assembly. Use the gallery reference to place the base, effects, spheres, and supports.

Collector note: The stated 15–16 cm measurement refers to the dragon figure, not the full illuminated base footprint. Measurements are approximate. Small differences in paint, color, and finish may occur. Intended for display; contains small components and should be kept away from young children.
